description: Find a bank, credit union or brokerage by name and say which finance apps likely connect to it. Pass `app` to focus on one app. If several institutions share the name, the largest is used and the others are listed; pass `state` or call get_institution with the right URL.

app.description: Optional app name or slug: rocket-money, lunch-money, monarch, copilot, ynab, simplifi, tiller, pocketguard, empower, wave, xero, quickbooks.

kind.description: Only return this kind of institution.

name.description: Institution name or brand, e.g. "Chase", "Navy Federal", "Fidelity".

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. "TX", to narrow common names.

name: check_institution
title: Check an institution
